+                with Horizontal(classes="actions"):

+                    yield Button("Expanded", id="write-expanded")
+                    yield Button("Follow Rich", id="follow-rich", variant="primary")

+"""Shared follow and viewport handling for the log widgets."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+from textual.geometry import Size
+from textual.message import Message
+from textual.scroll_view import ScrollView
+
+
+class LogScrollView(ScrollView):
+    """A scroll view which remembers whether the reader is following new lines."""
+
+    _following_end = True
+    _updating_log_scroll = False
+
+    @dataclass
+    class FollowChanged(Message):
+        """Posted only when the log's follow state changes."""
+
+        widget: LogScrollView
+        """The log whose follow state changed."""
+        is_following_end: bool
+        """Whether the log is following the end."""
+        scroll_y: float
+        """Vertical scroll position when the state changed."""
+        max_scroll_y: int
+        """Maximum vertical scroll position when the state changed."""
+
+        @property
+        def control(self) -> LogScrollView:
+            """The log whose follow state changed."""
+            return self.widget
+
+    @property
+    def is_following_end(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether new writes may follow the end when automatic scrolling is enabled."""
+        return self._following_end
+
+    def _set_following_end(self, following: bool) -> None:
+        """Update follow state, emitting a message only on a transition."""
+        if following != self._following_end:
+            self._following_end = following
+            self.post_message(
+                self.FollowChanged(self, following, self.scroll_y, self.max_scroll_y)
+            )
+
+    def watch_scroll_y(self, old_value: float, new_value: float) -> None:
+        # ScrollView refreshes the visible lines and updates the scrollbar.
+        super().watch_scroll_y(old_value, new_value)
+        if not self._updating_log_scroll:
+            if (
+                self.is_following_end
+                and new_value > old_value
+                and self.scroll_target_y == self.max_scroll_y
+            ):
+                # An animation towards the end is still following.
+                return
+            self._set_following_end(self.is_vertical_scroll_end)
+
+    def follow_end(self, animate: bool = False) -> None:
+        """Resume following and scroll to the end, optionally animating."""
+        self._set_following_end(True)
+        self._scroll_follow_end(animate)
+        self.call_after_refresh(self._scroll_follow_end, animate)
+
+    def _scroll_follow_end(self, animate: bool = False) -> None:
+        """Follow after layout only if the reader has not scrolled away."""
+        if self.is_following_end:
+            self.scroll_end(animate=animate, immediate=True, x_axis=False)
+
+    def _should_follow(self, auto_scroll: bool, scroll_end: bool | None) -> bool:
+        """Resolve a write's explicit scroll override or automatic follow policy."""
+        return not self.is_vertical_scrollbar_grabbed and (
+            auto_scroll and self.is_following_end if scroll_end is None else scroll_end
+        )
+
+    def _update_log_scroll(
+        self,
+        size: Size,
+        follow: bool,
+        removed: int = 0,
+        animate: bool = False,
+        scroll_y: float | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Update content size and retain the reader's position through pruning."""
+        position = self.scroll_y if scroll_y is None else scroll_y
+        self._updating_log_scroll = True
+        try:
+            self.virtual_size = size
+            if not follow:
+                self.scroll_y = max(0, position - removed)
+                self.scroll_target_y = self.scroll_y
+        finally:
+            self._updating_log_scroll = False
+        if follow:
+            self.follow_end(animate)
+        else:
+            self._set_following_end(self.is_vertical_scroll_end)
+        self.refresh()

+    def __init__(self, widget):
